knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Signs are recorded and the source is referred. Wiping and painting hide the evidence and risk spreading growth.
Dry disturbance of growth releases spores into the air, so visible growth is not dry brushed or vacuumed with household equipment.
The lesson says to work out where the water is coming from before any finish is covered or changed, because painting or sealing over a damp wall hides the evidence.

practicalCriteria: On a simulated wall with a stain and dark patches, the worker records each sign with location and time, keeps occupants clear, and does not disturb the growth.
The worker refers the moisture source and records that remediation is outside the inspection.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Observation record for the simulated wall
Referral note with the protection in place
stopWorkCriteria: Growth is extensive, hidden, or in a ceiling or subfloor void
Occupants or children are in the affected area
The worker is asked to disturb or remove growth
